title: IMDbPro Contact Scraper
description: Scrape people from an IMDbPro discovery URL and save the Direct Contact card only, exactly as it appears, for anyone whose Direct Contact includes an email.

startUrl.title: IMDbPro Discovery URL
startUrl.description: Paste the exact IMDbPro discovery/search URL you want to scrape, including your STARmeter range and any other filters already applied.

authState.title: IMDbPro Authentication State (optional)
authState.description: Leave this blank to use the session already built into the actor. Only fill this in if you want to run this specific job under a different IMDbPro session.

maxPages.title: Maximum Discovery Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of discovery pages to process. Use 0 for unlimited.

maxProfiles.title: Maximum Profiles
maxProfiles.description: Maximum number of people/profiles to process. Use 0 for unlimited.
